<p align="center">Plotdeck is an application used to plot cues and events for theatrical shows. Inspired by CuePilot.</p>

## Goals

- Be production ready. I want to use this tool in person, it needs to be capable.
- Be robust. Other people will be using it, it needs to withstand breaking issues.
- Work on all platforms. Users are everywhere.

## Non-goals

- Widespread adoption. CuePoints is still the industry standard. If it goes gain widespread adoption - amazing!
- Work on mobile. Not a focus for me, I want to get my workflow working first - and that's not on an ipad.

## Building from source

- Clone the repo and run cargo build.
